author: Apollo Laurent Bassette
title: Allow music to play in background
content: I’ve been playing brawl stars for close to 9 years. The game used to be a 4.5/5 which is really high for me. It was entertaining, matches were quick to start, and it was perfect for playing during short breaks or downtime. Recently, though, it seems and update made it so I can no longer listen to music in the background while playing. I’ve always played with my AirPods in while listening to music, and i’ve done that for so long that I honestly don’t even remember most of the game’s sound effects. Not being able to listen to my own music has taken a big part of what made the game enjoyable for me. Another major issue is opening Starr Drops and other rewards. Sometimes I just want top open the game, play a few quick matches, and get back to work or studying. Instead, I can end up having to sit through 20-30 drops with no option to skip or open them all at once. At this point, these issues bring the game down to about a 2/5 for me. Please bring the ability to listen to background music and add a “Skip” or “Open All” option for Drops. I think a lot of longtime players who already have most things unlocked would appreciate this. We don’t necessarily need an animation every time we receive a few coins,  Power Points, or another small reward. Sometimes we just want to get into a match and play. Until these issues are addressed, I personally don’t see myself nearly playing as much.

author: Review master007
title: Fun game, problems. Tips at bottom of review!
content:
I love this game, I’ve been playing for years and it’s always been fun to progress and get better, I would definitely recommend this app if you want fun online play or have some friends you wanna join in with, there are in app purchases to get good brawlers fast but you don’t need to do that, I have never spent any money on the game and I am a decent player. My only problem is I have recently been getting paired with new and not as experienced players, while playing against high level competition. My team gets killed and im often the last man standing and playing a 3 v 1. Making matchmaking more fair and paired with same trophy and skilled people would make the game more fun and fair when trying to gain rank or trophies. Overall I have no other complaints definitely worth a try and matchmaking isn’t completely lost, I still play and get trophies and have fun. Download the game, give it a try! (P.S. it takes some playing before you get really good so don’t delete because you get beat) 

TIPS:
1: higher trophies on a brawler better competition, lower trophies easy competition.
2: long range for open maps, short or mid range for bush or closed maps
3: focus on a getting a brawler you are good with to a high power level,
4: do your quests, you will be able to progress faster when you focus on quests. Guest = XP = starr drops, coins, power points, brawlers etc.

author: Wisepterodactyl
title: I wouldn’t bother
content: Honestly, Brawl Stars has all the ingredients to be fun, yet fails to be. The idea of unlocking new characters with different abilities and play styles, the strategy and countermoves it takes to win matches, and the option to play anywhere from multiplayer ranked games to friendly matches to simply training - it's all there. Unfortunately, it's all for naught because of the way the progression is set up. The app is designed for you to have to buy the brawl pass to get enough resources to upgrade a character. In my opinion, you should be able to upgrade a player to level 11 from simply the resources you get by prestiging them. As it stands, you'd be lucky to get past level 6. And that's if you get a character worth upgrading, only about 1 in 10 are. The one time I sniffed a legendary character was when I got enough blue credits for Crow, but when the game revealed him it crashed and I never received the character. About that, Id say maybe 1 in 7 matches the game fails to load and crashes. In some cases it makes me lose the match I never loaded into. Goodbye win streak, goodbye legendary player, It's a shame as well, because the gameplay is mostly strategy and counter moves... upgrading your character is a trivial aspect supercell makes a huge obstacle. I suggest being able to de-upgrade characters for a loss to be able to get back resources. Anyways, disappointed but this is very fixable!

author: Chexmisx
title: Unethical business tactics.
content:
You start to notice patterns with how their system runs, after playing for a while. Example… if the system recognizes you are winning too much, they will often throw you with an inexperienced team up against a significantly better team. The main purpose for this is so you keep playing, and keep wanting to win. They want you to get addicted to the dopamine cycle.

There are certain brawlers that are perfectly suited for certain maps, meaning there are also certain brawlers that are horrible for certain maps. Now brawl stars know this, and often, they will put you with a set of team that does not fit with the map. Raising your chances of losing, significantly. Or they will often just put you with low skilled players, after the system has recognized your wins. In order to reset that cycle of dopamine. 

(Most often win 3-5 times, lose 3 times. Repeated cycle)

Summary: there are games where you can dominate for hours on end with random teammates(fortnite, apex, cod). The way brawl stars functions however, is very unique yet obvious. You will often find yourself in a loop.
